notes.title: Global update for the Nightmares Awake demo
notes.notes:
We have updated the demo version and are happy to share the results. One of the major updates is localization. Our heroine now speaks Japanese so that every visitor to the Tokyo Game Show can understand her.

What has changed in the new demo version?
The demo location has been expanded to include a chapel

A mosaic puzzle has been added

The entire sound design has been completely reworked

Optimization and shadows have been improved

The Russian voice acting has been completely reworked

Additional phrases and English voice acting have been added

Japanese localization has been added



The result is 15 additional minutes of gameplay and a completely redesigned demo that will immerse you in the world of the great writer's works. We look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: Updated demo version of Nightmares Awake
notes.notes:
Friends, we continue to work hard on the project based on your feedback, so we have added a number of changes to the demo.


Key changes:
Mouse sensitivity settings requested by players have been implemented.

Bugs with saves have been fixed.

The materials in the room have been rebuilt and replaced, and the shaders and their usage have been greatly simplified.

Optimization has been improved, and the quality of a number of textures has been increased.

The bug with the firefly getting stuck has been fixed.

Added minor interface changes.

Added support for wide monitors.



We hope that the changes in the demo will allow players to once again immerse themselves in the dark atmosphere of Nightmares Awake, immerse themselves in our universe, and conquer their fears.
